notes.title: New DLC! Boob Lover is now available!
notes.content:
[h1]AI Solitaire - Boob Lover[/h1]

AI Solitaire - Boob Lover provides 12 new decks to use with AI Solitaire! This DLC is themed around beautiful girls with exagerated upper body proportions. If you are what one user called "virgin teenage boys" and prefer your women to knock you down every time they turn around, this is the DLC for you!

Last week we released AI Solitaire - Thin and Fit to satisfy a user who reviewed our game and called it "Silicone Solitaire" due to the abundance of well-endowed women who are a common theme in some of our card decks. AI Solitaire - Boob Lovers is to prove we aren't taking sides. We just like all beautiful women. AI Solitaire - Boob Lover features breasts in three sizes: Enormous, Gigantic, and Ludicrous!

P.S. Sorry for releasing a day late. My Boxer had five puppies yesterday and I got distracted!

notes.title: New DLC! Thin and Fit is now available!
notes.content:
[h1]AI Solitaire - Thin and Fit[/h1]

[b]AI Solitaire - Thin and Fit[/b] provides 3 new decks to use with AI Solitaire! This DLC is themed around beautiful girls with lean bodies. If you prefer your women with a more natural style, this is the DLC for you!

This DLC was made after reading a review from one faithful fan of [b]AI Solitaire[/b]. A user named [b]Crogar[/b] Gave us a great review after playing more than 200 hours. In it he refered to our game as "Silicone Solitaire" due to the abundance of well-endowed women who are a common theme in some of our card decks. We laughed out loud on reading the review. We can see what he means and we are happy to take honest feedback from anyone, but especially from someone with 200 hours of playtime! He ended the review with the following paragraph:

[h3]"In the rare instances where the developer created normal breasts the result is pure perfection. I highly recommend this game, both for virgin teenage boys who think gigantic breasts are the hottest thing in the world, and for mature who truly enjoy and exception solitaire game."[/h3]

Well, Crogar, this deck was created specifically with you in mind. We hope you enjoy a healthy dose of "pure perfection!"

Sincerely,

Denki Gaka

P.S. For the "virgin teenage boys" out there, next week we will be releasing an actual deck devoted to "Silicone Solitaire." The next DLC is called AI Solitaire - Boob Lover and features breasts in three sizes: Enormous, Gigantic, and Ludicrous!

notes.title: Single Ladies Aisha DLC is out now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993133/8f73dd1c711a9cd701f8db10b6c9ac98b38cd36c.png[/img]

[h1]Single Ladies Aisha DLC[/h1]

We ran into a problem when we tried to get the Single Ladies Season Pass we announced approved. Because some of the content was yet to be finished, and the intended content included images meant for more mature audiences, Steam "blocked" the approval of our Season Pass store page. Unfortunately, that block caused a log jam on all of the Single Ladies DLC packs we had submitted, as well.

Blocking the individual girl DLC packs was an unintended result of the block on the season pass. The good news is that the problem is finally resolved. The bad news is that it took more then two months to get it resolved.

So now we have three girls (Aisha, Diana, and Casey) approved for release. We are releasing Aisha today (8/17), Diana on Tuesday (8/20), and Casey on Friday (8/23). Now that the approval process for our store pages is back on track, we will be releasing additional girls as soon as they are approved until we catch up with the intended release schedule of one girl every Wednesday. It will take several weeks to get back to our intended release schedule, but that means that we will often be releasing more than one girl per week.

As for the Season Pass, we are out of luck on that. However, we can create a discounted bundle that includes each girl as we release her. We are working to get that set up right now, but we have never used this kind of bundle before, so we will see how long that takes to get setup and approved. The way that bundle will work is that it will offer a steep discount for buying the complete collection versus the individual pricing. You will only pay for any content you are missing when you first purchase it, and as new DLC in the series are added, you can update your bundle by purchasing only the new content at the same discount as the rest of the bundle.

A bundle is not the way we wanted to do this series, but it is the only option currently available to us.

If you have been waiting for new content, grab Aisha today. Keep an eye out for Diana and Casey next week, and the Bundle of all the Single Ladies as soon as we can get it approved.
